ValidationRule.description: This is the validation rule to ensure that all Project and Contact related fields are populated before the lead is converted, condition being; if a Project is to be created after the lead conversion.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Converted'), Create_Project__c = TRUE, OR( ISBLANK(Project_Name__c), ISBLANK(Project_Address__c), ISBLANK(Project_City__c), ISBLANK(Project_State__c), ISBLANK(Project_Zip_Code__c), ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(MobilePhone) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill all fields under Project and Contact Information.
